chapter: Annex, Cadillac and the Ory-Oliver band
title: Playing piano at Gertrude Dix's next to Anderson's Annex
summary: He played piano for Gertrude Dix's house beside Tom Anderson's Annex Saloon, then was sent to Anderson's son-in-law's cabaret.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Mr. Tom Anderson sent for me. His... My wife's... ...lady friend, I'll say. ...was Gertrude Dix. She ran... The house was called a brass railing. It was right next... ...to Mr. Anderson's Annex Saloon. Mr. Anderson's Annex Saloon. And, uh... I went to wake over there for her. Miss Dix. Well, I played there... ...about... ...or around about... ...eight or nine months.
How old were you by then? About...

...around about 60. And so... the son-in-law. His son-in-law. Open... ...a cabaret... ...on ramparts... ...between the canal... ...and the them. The son-in-law, Tom Anderson's son-in-law, his name was George Delcy. So, it says now we're going to change and want you to go in over and play for my son-in-law. Nice place.
I'd like to ask you a question about the Annex. When you were playing at the Annex, was it only a piano or was it a band there?
No, no, only a piano. Only a piano, just sort of the same system as Miss Luma's.
Were you at the Annex or at Gertrude Dix's? Which were you in?
Well, her name was Gertrude Dix. See? The saloon was the Annex Saloon. Stannis and Saloon, they called it the Annex. Right on Basin. Right on Basin. And I was there. On the corner.
And, uh, and you were working in the saloon, huh?
Huh? You were in the saloon? No, her house was next door to the saloon. Yes, Saloon.
That's the big house. Was that Gertrude Dix's at first and then did Josie Arlington buy it later? What was that? Or was it Hilma Burt? I forget. This is Anderson's place on the corner.
That's it. Next door.
Next door.
Uh-huh. That was Miss Gertrude Dix.
So, he wasn't playing the Annex at first. No, it was an X, though. No, the Annex was the one on the corner. Anderson, is that right? Mm-hmm. That's right. Tom Anderson.
What did they call it? The Annex.
Uh-huh. They didn't call it the Arlington Annex, though. Or just call it the Annex?
Arlington Annex.
They call the whole thing?
Annex, yeah.
It's the Annex.
